name: AdZen Native Keyword Earning Plugin Light
author: sharedvision

sections.description:
Welcome to AdZen! A new and simple way to earn passive income from your website.
Your first step is to install the AdZen plugin and verify website ownership using our API key (provided to you during your account setup, or by going to this link after signup)

What is AdZen?

Adzen is a new-to-market platform that enables Brands and Publishers/Creators (Publishers) to do business together. Ultimately, it is a new passive income stream for Publishers like you. You’ve probably made money through display ads, sponsorships, or even affiliate links. This is an additional passive income stream that sits along side your other earning streams.
It works using a unique marketing asset that we invented called Native Keywords. Native Keywords are words that you write in your web-posts, emails, and in your social media that brands find valuable enough to pay per click for.
This is a 2-sided marketplace with Brands on one side and you (Publishers) on the other. Our Brands bid on and pay for Native Keywords by click. As a Publisher, you provide the content where our Native Keyword links are placed and you get paid for every valid click of that Native Keyword.

Please visit our pages to learn more:

  • https://adzen.ai/publisher
  • https://adzen.ai/terms-and-conditions
  • https://adzen.ai/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the AdZen plugin

1) Install

* Go to the WordPress Dashboard "Add New Plugin" section.
* Search For "AdZen Native Keyword Earning Plugin Light"
* Install, then Activate it.

2) Configure

* Go to the AdZen Setup Page: https://pub.adzen.ai/paid-per-click/step2
* Copy your API Key
* Go back to your WordPress editor dashboard and highlight Settings in the left menu. Select AdZen. You will find a field where you will add the API key
* Go back to your setup page and verify. Then you're done!
sections.faq:
How do I create and apply for an AdZen account?

Go to https://pub.adzen.ai/apply to apply for a free account.

What does the plugin do?

The AdZen plugin places a script on your website which allows our Native Keyword earning system to place Native Keyword links onto your website so that you can passively earn income.

How do I set up the plugin completely, including the API key?

You must install the plugin and enter the API key in order for the system to work properly. You must have an AdZen account and have begun the setup process. Install this plugin and You can get your API Key on Step 2 of the setup process. To get your API key, log into your AdZen account and go to this link: https://pub.adzen.ai/paid-per-click/step2
